faq.sottotitolo: Answers to the most common questions about vegan nutrition
faq.d1-domanda: Is it really possible to get all nutrients from a vegan diet?
faq.d1-risposta: Absolutely yes! A well-planned vegan diet provides all essential nutrients. I'll guide you in choosing the right foods and, when necessary, appropriate supplements to ensure maximum wellbeing.
faq.d2-domanda: How long does it take to see the first results?
faq.d2-risposta: The first benefits are noticed in the first 2-3 weeks: more energy, better digestion and a sense of lightness. More significant results on weight and blood parameters are generally seen within 2-3 months.
faq.d3-domanda: How much does a vegan diet cost?
faq.d3-risposta: Contrary to popular belief, vegan nutrition can be more affordable! Legumes, grains, vegetables and fruits are often cheaper than meat. I'll teach you how to shop intelligently and cost-effectively.
faq.d4-domanda: Is it suitable for children and the elderly?
faq.d4-risposta: Yes, vegan nutrition is suitable for all ages when well planned. I create specific plans for children, teenagers, pregnancy, breastfeeding and seniors, always with the support of the pediatrician or doctor.
faq.d5-domanda: Can I do sports with a vegan diet?
faq.d5-risposta: Certainly! Many professional athletes follow vegan diets with excellent results. I'll help you optimize nutrition for your sports activities, ensuring optimal energy and recovery.
faq.d6-risposta: Consultations take place via video calls on secure platforms. You'll receive preliminary questionnaires, personalized meal plans by email and continuous support via WhatsApp for urgent questions.

hero.sottotitolo: Welcome to the world of Viva Plant Nutrition! I'm Arianna, and I'm excited to guide you on your journey towards conscious, healthy and joyful vegan nutrition.
hero.missione: My mission is to demonstrate that plant-based nutrition is not only an ethical choice, but also the path to optimal wellbeing.

storia.p1: Hello! I'm Arianna, the mind and heart behind Viva Plant Nutrition.
storia.p2: My story is a deep journey, born from an ethical choice that has shaped every step. Vegan for over ten years, I embraced this lifestyle out of love and respect for animals. I remember well the initial difficulties, the lack of information and an adequate support network. It was from those challenges that my determination was born: I wanted to help others navigate this journey with greater ease and awareness.
storia.p3: After a degree in Languages in Turin in 2017 and professional training as an educator in Germany from 2020, I decided to combine my passions. I transformed my commitment to the plant world into a profession, becoming a Nutritionist. My experience as a mother of a wonderful child, raised vegan from pregnancy, gave me a unique perspective and deep empathy for the challenges and joys that women face at every stage of their lives.
storia.p4: My goal is to guide you towards a vegan diet that makes you feel your best - sustainable, delicious and aligned with your values.

come-funziona.sottotitolo: A personalized program that guides you step by step towards your wellbeing
come-funziona.step1-testo: We start with a free 15-minute consultation to understand your goals, your needs and answer all your questions.

altre-spec.sottotitolo: A scientific and empathetic approach for every life stage
altre-spec.svezzamento-testo: From first purees to independent eating. I guide you through weaning with particular attention to safe cutting techniques and building a peaceful relationship with food from an early age.
altre-spec.patologie-testo: Not just diet, but therapy. I help you manage conditions such as IBS, gastritis, insulin resistance, diabetes or hormonal imbalances (PCOS, endometriosis). We develop specific protocols to reduce symptoms.
altre-spec.famiglia-testo: No more cooking three different meals! We develop a single, healthy and tasty menu that meets the needs of adults and children. Less stress in the kitchen, better health for the whole family.
altre-spec.transizione-testo: Want to embrace the plant world? I guide you through a gradual transition, without deficiencies and without deprivation. You'll discover new flavors and learn how to perfectly balance the vegan plate.
altre-spec.menopausa-testo: Symptom management through nutrition. Support for this natural life transition phase.
altre-spec.sport-testo: Maximize your training results. We improve performance and muscle recovery through targeted nutritional strategies. Together we prove that high athletic performance is possible even with plant-based nutrition.

policy-cancellazione.meta-descrizione: Cancellation and refund policy for Viva Plant Nutrition consultations.
policy-cancellazione.h1-intro: You can reschedule your appointment independently via the link in your confirmation email, within the following time frames:
h1-lista: More than 7 days before: free rescheduling with no restrictions.
2 to 7 days before: rescheduling allowed once only.
Less than 24 hours before: self-service rescheduling is not available. Contact Arianna Ciervo directly at info@vivaplantnutrition.com — each case will be assessed individually.
h2-lista: More than 7 days before: full refund. Contact Arianna Ciervo at info@vivaplantnutrition.com.
2 to 7 days before: no refund. You may reschedule to a future date.
Less than 24 hours before or no-show: no refund; session is considered completed.
h3-lista: Cancellation before the first visit: full refund by contacting Arianna Ciervo at info@vivaplantnutrition.com.
Cancellation after the first visit: no refund. The program is considered started.
Rescheduling individual sessions: same policy as single visits (see point 1).
No-show or cancellation with less than 24 hours' notice: the session is considered completed, unless Arianna Ciervo decides otherwise at her discretion.
Session expiry: sessions must be used within 6 months of the first visit for the 3-Month Program, and within 12 months for the 6-Month Program. Unused sessions expire without the right to a refund.
policy-cancellazione.h4-testo: The free consultation can be cancelled at any time with no penalty. At least 24 hours' notice is appreciated.
policy-cancellazione.h5-testo: Bookings paid by bank transfer must be confirmed by payment within 72 hours of booking. After this deadline, if no payment is received, the booking is automatically cancelled and the slot is made available again.
policy-cancellazione.h6-testo: For any queries, write to info@vivaplantnutrition.com.
